reviewNotes: Historical English-fork display/compatibility/sample reviews are retained; c28900e reviews multilingual display boundaries and Windows capabilities, and the 1d5a774 follow-up separately reviews durable ledger recovery and broker-acknowledged protection. These approvals are not a language-only behavior-equivalence claim.

Trading/account/storage identities remain stable. New shipped samples use English code identifiers; existing user code is not renamed automatically. The explicitly authorized local five-file migration had backups, no saved references, token-equivalence checks and identical default/custom-parameter replays. Existing regression tests still cover legacy ledger/parameter/template recovery.
Template raw C# is fingerprinted recursively, ignoring only comments and string text, so indicator/strategy math is not hidden by the raw-string envelope.
This file is a reviewed allowlist, not a request to suppress future failures. Investigate and review every new exception or structural hash.
Final visual review: live-launch dropdown refreshes compiled display metadata; the data-page action row sits below the full-width title to avoid narrow-window clipping.

Reviewed sample-only identifier renames in StrategyCatalog, UserScripts and CodeEditorWindow: class/file/parameter/private/local names are English; numeric expressions and control flow are unchanged after the explicit old-to-new identifier map. No trading-engine or provider protocol change. The actual New indicator template has a red/green regression check.

The baseline remains 9ee74a4c527ac43120423acd41e006ec9d7877ad, not the rolling upstream checkpoint. Every approvedStructure path has an individual reviewedFiles reason; added C# files require their own exact structural fingerprint rather than folder approval.

Canonical C# and new-code templates remain English. Only exact locale/native-language labels and documented protocol/persistence/data constants are literal exceptions. Runtime es/zh-CN JSON catalogs and retained non-English documentation are not source-code exemptions; English UI/documentation/code-example gates remain in place.

Numeric tokens, identifiers, control flow and recursively parsed strategy/indicator raw-template code remain fingerprinted by the existing Roslyn algorithm; no source-structure, added-file or Spanish-candidate gate is disabled. This inventory records source review only; builds, regressions, isolated multilingual UI and native Windows runtime/restart evidence belong to separate release gates.

The reviewed ledger now uses generation-bound checksummed append intents, disk flushes, bounded fresh-process replay and an interprocess lease. This is process-crash consistency, not power-loss durability, broker-event exactly-once delivery or authoritative execution accounting. Local reducing markers and sibling coordination remain distinct from exchange-native OCO/reduce-only; unknown submission attribution remains session-local.

Display labels become English without changing account IDs or close-order tag prefixes. This is source review, not a broker atomicity guarantee.
Retains English display metadata/legacy storage identities and adds Language/saved-settings detection. Profile changes mark old Tradovate broker contexts replaced, retaining their native session/feed transport for charts, exposure, unknown snapshots and pending runners; new consumers use the new context. Confirmed-idle cleanup and shutdown dispose retired/replaced contexts. Removes the unused OpenAccounts helper; real-order origin guards remain active.
Appends the selected prose-language override while requiring English generated code; uses the common Windows-safe CLI preparation and exact UTF-8 stdin transport for oversized prompts, retaining requested tools/workspace/permissions.
reviewedFiles.src/TradingHub.App/Services/ClaudeCode.c: Reviews Windows installer/npm/WinGet/PATH/bundled discovery, case-insensitive Windows path caching, native-exe preference, recursive batch-shim resolution to node/native targets and exact argument transport (no cmd evaluation of prompts). Oversized prompts move to UTF-8 stdin. Keeps subscription-session isolation, Git Bash configuration and English code instructions with selected-language prose.
Retains exact legacy Simulator-name migration and stable credential keys; routes isolated fake JSON, native Windows Credential Manager and existing macOS Keychain through ISecretStore. Windows credential failures propagate to callers. Feed invalidation retains consumed Tradovate transports until confirmed idle, and DisposeAll includes retired feeds rather than severing active account management.

Start and restart include contract preparation in the visible I/O error boundary. Resume persists actual runner pause state, and reset/delete keep the record when persistence fails. Existing exposure remains managed.
reviewedFiles.src/TradingHub.App/Services/LiveRiskAgen: Retains English prompts, platform CLI guidance and stable proposal tags; incomplete member history refuses automated review before any model request or risk change. Real-account proposals still require approval.

reviewedFiles.src/TradingHub.Core/Feeds/Binance/Binanc: Retains signed protocol constants, Spot free+locked recovery, native Futures reduceOnly and separate algo identities. Preassigned client IDs bind ambiguous acceptance to the original handle without new-placement retries; unresolved replay stays not-ready. Native amendment confirmation and latest queued prices preserve one handle. Saved detached IDs still cancel nonterminal orders.
reviewedFiles.src/TradingHub.Core/Feeds/Rithmic/Rithmi: Retains the reviewed atomic working-order publication, partial-fill/replay and reducing-exit behavior. Process-qualified client tags and provisional handles survive unknown submission and delayed native binding; cancel intent no longer expires after two seconds. Native amendment completion requires actual reported price/quantity, retains stable ownership, and coalesces the latest queued move. Protocol fields and permissions stay stable; simple orders still lack exchange-native reduce-only/OCO.

Retains explicit position/order replay readiness. Correlates submissions by retained user tag and supplies raw working-report price/quantity for amendment acknowledgment rather than treating command receipts or optimistic local values as broker confirmation. Reconnect stays unknown until replay; protocol field IDs and account identities remain stable.
reviewedFiles.src/TradingHub.Core/Feeds/Tradovate/Trad: Explicitly reviewed path: order submission can disable transport retries, carries the existing client-tag protocol field for exact replay correlation, and retains unknown old-session commands. Pending amendment state is acknowledged by working-order reports; unrelated connection/authentication behavior and account identities are preserved.

Makes chart-route publication and orphan-packet buffering atomic under one gate; buffered packets are drained under the route lock before later packets or end-of-history can overtake them. A forced interleaving reproduced history completing with zero delivered buffered packets before the fix. Existing public paginated-history assertions still require all 12 ticks, prices, order, aggressor sides and cancellation. Payloads, contract IDs, cursors and historical data formats are unchanged.

Retains complete-snapshot readiness, late/partial fills, reducing exits and old-context retention. Ambiguous placement binds by exact client tag without automatic resubmission; cancellation survives replay and command receipt until actual terminal acknowledgment. Tracked native amendments wait for reported price/total quantity, clear on terminal orders and dispatch only the latest queued move with then-current remaining size. A newer ready-state price supersedes an older disconnect queue before broker sync. No native atomic OCO is claimed.
reviewedFiles.src/TradingHub.Core/Trading/Brackets.cs: Explicitly reviewed path: owned entries/exits remain tracked through acceptance, cancellation and amendments without timeout-based release. Both snapshots must be ready; disappearance/rejection is not a target fill. Execution deltas cap protection until position callbacks catch up. Native tracked amendments retain the same handle; unsupported fallback waits for terminal cancellation before replacement. Dispose keeps pending ownership, and optional message subscribers no longer decide whether an order action executes. Coordination is not broker-atomic OCO.
reviewedFiles.src/TradingHub.Core/Trading/ITradingAcco: Retains readiness/market Exit and local reducing semantics. Adds an optional tracked-amendment acknowledgment contract so consumers can retain an order handle until actual working state settles; synchronous/default accounts do not acquire invented asynchronous capability flags. Local reduction remains distinct from exchange enforcement.
reviewedFiles.src/TradingHub.Core/Trading/SimBroker.cs: Retains reducing market/stop/limit construction, synchronous fills and legacy account identity. Implements tracked amendment completion as synchronous and preserves the same order handle; no real-provider or atomic OCO claim.
reviewedFiles.src/TradingHub.Indicators.Native/Basic.c: Explicitly reviewed path: removes only CumulativeDeltaCandles' unread unused _base field and its empty effective recalculation override, eliminating CS0414. reviewedFiles.src/TradingHub.Indicators.Native/Session: Repairs UI-thread historical replay allocation without removing the indicator or changing its parameters, identifiers, aggregation, POC/value-area math, colors or drawing. Closed bars still accumulate once, but draw-only dictionary/sorted snapshots are materialized at session/week boundaries and the current bar rather than every historical bar. The managed stack identified this path during a normal-profile startup stall.
